tasks.title: Docs: narration/ntfy removal, .cairn_ prefix wording, unpin step, blocked-log exception
tasks.notes:
Docs-only task (TDD n/a for prose; no failing test to record). Claims checked against src/temp-sweep.ts, src/brand.ts, src/config.ts, src/index.ts (lib/ and src/narration.ts confirmed gone; BRAND has no socket/pidFile).
- README.md: removed the ntfy prerequisite, the narration clause of the API-key sentence (it now covers only claude's use), the `cairn narrate` command rows, the Voice Narration and Push Notifications sections, the cairn.json `narration` block and narration.* config rows, and the narrate.ts, lib/ and "narration forwarding" file-tree entries.
- CLAUDE.md (a)-(h): dropped narrate from the command list and the Narration bullet; removed socket/pidFile from the BRAND fields; removed the lib/ sentence; limited the BRAND standing rule to dataDir/configFile -> findDataDir/findConfigFile. Temp-sweep bullet: `.ralph_` (NOTES_TEMP_PREFIX) is now called the permanent spelling and `.cairn_` (BRAND.tempPrefix) the defensive one. Documented the blocked-log exception to match temp-sweep.ts: a blocked task's _tests.log is kept, its prompt/review-prompt/notes are still swept, and every log is kept if tasks.json is missing, unreadable, unparseable or has no tasks array. It is best-effort. Unpin steps now include `cairn round next` plus the reason and the safety note.
- docs/parallel-execution-rfc.md: removed the "Single narration socket" point. §6 became "(Removed)" with a one-paragraph historical note so the numbering stays stable. Removed the §6 narration mention in Rollout. Fixed a stale §6 cross-ref in §4 (it concerns snapshot/task-file timing) to §7.2, §7.3.
- src/brand.ts: the NOTES_TEMP_PREFIX docblock had wrongly said NOTES_TEMPFILE_RE lives in run.ts; it is in temp-sweep.ts.
- Final grep for narrat|ntfy|kokoro finds only the deliberate historical note in RFC §6. typecheck green; bun test 1154 pass / 0 fail.
- Reminder for the user, not done here per the constraints: cairn.json still has its narration block and the pinned healthCheck.
